data.refund_policy:
At DSM Online, we strive to provide high-quality electronic components to our customers. To ensure clarity, please review our return policy below :

No Payment Refunds : We do not provide refunds for any payments made. Once a purchase is completed, the payment is considered final.
Product Exchange : If you receive a defective or damaged product, you may request an exchange. All exchange requests must be made within 7 days of receiving the product. While unboxing kindly make video at a time.

The product must be unused, in its original packaging, and in the same condition as when you received it.
Proof of purchase (invoice or receipt) is required for any exchange.

While unboxing the product, make a video of it so that if any of your products is damaged or changed, you can give that video to the seller and ask for the amount return. Without the unboxing video, you will not get the amount return.

Non-Returnable Items : The following items are not eligible for exchange:
Products damaged due to customer mishandling.
Items that have been customized or altered.
Shipping Costs: Customers are responsible for any shipping costs associated with returning the item for exchange.
Processing Time : Upon receiving your item, we will inspect it and notify you of the approval or rejection of your exchange request. The exchange process typically takes 5-7 business days from the time we receive the returned item
data.shippingAndDelivery:
Fast and Reliable Shipping: At Dsm online, we understand the importance of timely and secure delivery. That's why we have partnered with trusted shipping providers to ensure your products reach you quickly and in excellent condition.

Free Shipping : on Orders Over Rs 500 Enjoy free shipping on all orders over Rs 500 . We want to make your shopping experience even more convenient by eliminating any additional shipping costs for qualifying orders.

Multiple Shipping Options: We offer a range of shipping options to accommodate your preferences. During checkout, you can choose from various delivery methods, including standard shipping, expedited shipping, or overnight delivery. Simply select the option that best suits your needs.

Order Processing Time: Once you've successfully placed an order with us, our dedicated team works diligently to process and ship it as quickly as possible. We typically begin processing orders within 1-2 business days. During peak seasons or holidays, processing times may be slightly longer due to increased order volumes. The customer will receive the order within 5-6 business days

Track Your Order: To keep you informed about the status of your purchase, we provide a unique tracking number for each order. Once your order is shipped, we'll send you an email containing the tracking details. You can then use the provided link or enter the tracking number on our website to monitor your package's journey until it reaches your doorstep.

Secure Packaging: We take great care in packaging your items to protect them during transit. Our team uses secure packaging materials to safeguard your order and ensure it arrives in perfect condition, ready for you to enjoy.

Exceptional Customer Support: If you have any questions or concerns regarding your order or delivery, our friendly customer support team is here to assist you. Feel free to contact us via email, phone, or live chat, and we'll be more than happy to help.
